hypothesis: Removing mandatory benchmark planning reviews while retaining native command grammar, factual observations, memory and accounting lets the model choose and execute its own strategy.
notes: A new exploratory condition, not comparable as the same condition to legacy probe or continuation v1 results.
Only type, params and advance_ticks are required. Planning notes are optional; malformed notes cannot reject a valid native command.
Grammar repairs never choose gameplay or synthesize WAIT. Native legality and bounded costs remain enforced.
The eight legal action families remain a limited interface, not full Dwarf Fortress control. Observations omit benchmark targets and prescribed strategy.
max_steps bounds each segment; dispatch, token and returned-cost limits are cumulative across campaign recovery. Three steps are a development check, not the year-two horizon.
The retained starting save is not a fresh embark. This condition alone establishes neither viability nor a model ranking.
